description: Use when writing Apex that calls out to external endpoints via Named Credentials, working with custom header formula tokens ({!$Credential.OAuthToken}), querying per-user auth state through the UserExternalCredential SObject, or diagnosing why Named Credential callouts fail. Trigger keywords: 'callout: prefix', 'named credential header formula', 'UserExternalCredential', 'External Credential per-user principal', 'Named Credential oauth token apex'. NOT for Named Credential setup in the Salesforce Setup UI — use integration/named-credentials-setup. NOT for general HTTP callout mechanics (HttpRequest, HttpResponse, mock patterns) — use apex/callouts-and-http-integrations.
inputs: Named Credential API name and model (legacy vs. enhanced)
Auth type in use: OAuth, Basic, or Custom Headers
Whether per-user (Named Principal) or org-wide (Per-User Principal) auth is needed
Any custom header formula tokens required in the callout
name: apex-named-credentials-patterns
official_sources: Apex Developer Guide — "Named Credentials as Callout Endpoints" (`apexdev` L34318–34410): the `callout:` URL scheme, query-string appending, environment portability across orgs, and the one-file endpoint change. https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/salesforce_apex_developer_guide.pdf

Apex Developer Guide — "Custom Headers and Bodies" and "Merge Fields for Apex Callouts That Use Named Credentials" (`apexdev` L34413–34518): the six `$Credential` merge fields, that they are used in Apex `setHeader`/`setBody`, the Allow-Merge-Fields prerequisite, the `HTMLENCODE` body-only rule, and the SOAP no-refresh caveat.

Apex Developer Guide — "Callout Limits and Limitations" (`apexdev` L35841–35860) and "Make Long-Running Callouts with Continuations" (`apexdev` L36000–36067, L36288–36303): the 10-second default and 120,000 ms maximum timeout, the 120-second cumulative budget, the 100-callouts-per-transaction ceiling, that Continuations accept a named credential URL, and the Private Connect exclusion.
Apex Developer Guide — anonymous-block permission table (`apexdev` L14750–14758): Customize Application is required when an anonymous Apex callout references a named credential as its endpoint.

Metadata API Developer Guide — `ExternalCredential` and `ExternalCredentialParameter` (`api_meta` L63601–63930): the `authenticationProtocol` enum, the `parameterType` enum including `AuthHeader`, `AuthParameter`, `NamedPrincipal` and `PerUserPrincipal`, `sequenceNumber` semantics, and the removal of `principal` at API 58.0. https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/api_meta.pdf

Metadata API Developer Guide — `NamedCredential` and `NamedCredentialParameter` (`api_meta` L89887–90425): the `namedCredentialType` enum, `generateAuthorizationHeader` / `allowMergeFieldsInHeader` / `allowMergeFieldsInBody` defaults, `calloutStatus`, the `Url` / `Authentication` / `HttpHeader` / `AllowedManagedPackageNamespaces` / `ManagedByNamespace` parameter types, and the legacy-only status of `endpoint` and `protocol`.

Metadata API Developer Guide — `PermissionSet.externalCredentialPrincipalAccesses` and `PermissionSetExternalCredentialPrincipalAccess` (`api_meta` L94794–95004): the API 59.0 availability and the dash-joined, namespace-prefixed `externalCredentialPrincipal` format.

Object Reference for the Salesforce Platform — `NamedCredential` object (`object_reference` L185778–186040): the supported calls, the View Setup and Configuration access rule, the `CalloutOptions*` verification fields, the legacy-only status of `Endpoint` and `PrincipalType`, and the per-user re-authentication warning. https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/object_reference.pdf

Apex Reference Guide — `Test.setMock(Type, Object)` (`apexrefguide` L240946–240970), `HttpCalloutMock.respond(HttpRequest)` (`apexrefguide` L216168–216210), and the `SurveyInvitationLinkShortener` sample (`apexrefguide` L196204–196226): the mock contract for testing Named Credential callouts, and a published example combining a `callout:` endpoint with merge-field header and body values.
Salesforce Well-Architected — Security and Operational Excellence pillars: the framing for the pillar notes above. https://architect.salesforce.com/docs/architect/well-architected/guide/overview.html
outputs: Apex callout implementation using Named Credential with correct syntax
Custom header formula token usage for injecting OAuth tokens or credentials
UserExternalCredential SOQL query for per-user token status checks
Guidance on Enhanced vs. Legacy model differences affecting Apex code
